subject: The shortcut power users won't share
preview_text: Stop wasting time on form guides. The top 5% of Predictify users all do this one thing before every race.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when you've been staring at a racecard for 20 minutes and still can't decide? The form guides blur together, the stats start to feel meaningless, and you just end up guessing. There's a faster way. The sharpest punters on Predictify don't read every detail — they let the AI surface what matters.

Here's what they do: before any race, they open the racecard and tap the 'AI Summary' button. It's not hidden, but nobody talks about it. It takes all those variables — jockey form, track bias, weight carry, speed ratings — and distills them into one actionable read. It's like having a form guide that's already been studied by a data scientist and a racing expert.

The summary gives you the horse's confidence score, the key factor that could swing the race, and a clear 'bet or skip' recommendation. Power users don't waste time on analysis paralysis. They get the insight in 10 seconds and move on. That's the shortcut.

Open Predictify now and try it on today's racecard. See how fast you can get from confused to confident. P.S. Premium users get the AI Summary for every race, plus the 3-day free trial is still available if you haven't tried it yet.
